text.text:
What you're saying doesn't make much sense though, because if a player dominated on 2 maps and sucks on 1, the rating will still be above average. For example - 1.50 rating map1, 0.40 map2 and 1.40 map3 gives U an average of 1.10, that's not exactly flat considering you had 0.40 on map2, is it? 

The average rating is the perfect metric, it's just objectively telling us about overall performance of a player in the match. 

Maybe what you'd like to see would be a "round swing" metric, something taken into consideration in rating 3.0 beta?
